notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Urban Daggertooth has at least one +1/+1 counter.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Pandemonium, dealing 1 damage to Urban Daggertooth.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 2.
